s: Just go to WoWHead and search Tame Beast [it will be under "Abilities"], then take the numbers after "spell=" in the url. Go into WoW as a GM and use the command ".learn x" to the hunter, where "x" is the number you got from the url. The hunter now has the ability to tame his own pet.
